message: iam:CreateRole without iam:PermissionsBoundary condition — role can be created with any permissions
iam:AttachRolePolicy granted without iam:PermissionsBoundary or iam:PolicyARN condition — any managed policy including AdministratorAccess can be attached to any role matching @{RoleName}

iam:PutRolePolicy granted without iam:PermissionsBoundary condition — arbitrary inline policy (e.g., Action: *, Resource: *) can be injected into any role matching @{RoleName}, granting uncapped permissions
